title: Quintic surfaces with 18 cusps
summary: We construct quintic surfaces in the three-dimensional projective space $\mathbb P^3$ with $18$ ordinary cusps. Our starting point is the Barth--Rams description of quintics containing a $3$-divisible set of $12$ cusps. A specialization in which the two contact cubics are singular along two skew lines produces a family with $16$ cusps, and examples with $18$ cusps can be found over small finite fields.
